The weekend we were staying at Desert Blue there was a marathon on the Sunday.    On Saturday we had our own transportation to the strip and planned on taking the shuttle back from Caesars.   After waiting an hour an no sign of a shuttle I called the resort.  They advised they cancelled their shuttle service due to road closures because of the marathon.   The marathon was not due to start for another 24 hours and there were no road closures in the area on the Saturday.   I asked the front desk why there was no notice to guests that the shuttle would not be  running and they did not have an answer.  She suggested to try to get on the Rio shuttle and walk back from the Rio.     I asked if the Rio was shuttling Wyndham guests and she said "no but it's worth a try if they just take you rather than a cab or Uber".  Sunday,  the day of the marathon there were still no street closures around the area.  Again the front desk had no explanation as to why the shuttle would have been cancelled.   The resort did not seem to be concerned with leaving guests stranded.

reviews.title: Great Vegas Timeshare
reviews.text: What an immaculate, well maintained resort! There is a beautiful outdoor pool area with patio bar and grill. There is easy access to the main strip by car or shuttle. The staff was friendly and responsive.

reviews.title: A Truly Excellent Resort!!!!

reviews.title: Stay somewhere else.
reviews.text: Says they have shuttle service to and from the Strip.  Only if they have room.  Don’t care if they strand you on the Strip.  So figure in a few Ubers back from the Strip as part of your budget to stay here.  Recommend staying at the other Wyndham off the strip that you are not help hostage to their shuttle service.  And a typical Wyndham - the driver’s response when he stranded us - what should we do.  “ I don’t give a sh__.”

reviews.title: Shuttle service
reviews.text: Let’s address the shuttle. Don’t book this place on your expectations of having shuttle service you can rely on. First off, the last shuttle ride during the week is at 9:30 pm. On the weekends it runs til 1:30 am. What the resort fails to tell you anywhere (website, checkin, on literature) is that the shuttle has a seat capacity limit of around 20. It fills up really fast, and if your not at the front of the line, you may miss out.  Once the seats fill up, they will deny you boarding. There is no standing room, and there isn’t another shuttle to take overflow. You have to wait another hour for the next one. Everyone gets burned, until you learn that you have to show up well before the shuttle arrives and be prepared to scurry to the door as it’s pulling up to avoid being at the back of the line. Oh, did I mention that people also “save” seats for other family members, so you may not get a seat even if there are still empty seats that are being saved. If you complain to the resort, they will tell you it’s a complimentary service and run by a third party company so there is nothing they can do. If you have dinner reservations or show tickets, don’t rely on the shuttle. Oh yeah, you also can’t bring your own alcohol to the pool, you have to buy their expensive drinks. I wish I knew about these things before we booked. Hopefully others will learn from our experience.

reviews.title: Convenient close to the strip
reviews.text: It's a nice , clean and relatively new hotel. It provides a free shuttle service with a very convenient schedule that takes you to the the Caesars Palace hotel from where you can walk to all the different casinos -  hotels on  the srip or go to some shows if that's your plan..

reviews.title: Family stay for a soccer tournament
reviews.text: We traveled to Vegas for my daughter’s soccer tournament. We were looking for a hotel close to the strip but not in the middle of the craziness. We booked this hotel last minute and we were impressed. The hotel was nice, modern and clean. The staff was friendly and super efficient. Free parking and valet parking; super convenient with the app that allows you to order your car in advance. The rooms are spacious and clean. The carpets in the hallways and rooms can use a deep cleaning though; overall a very clean hotel. Housekeeping is not available unless you pay but, if you are planning on staying only a couple of days it is not a big deal. You will be approached to attend a presentation; similar to timeshare they do try to sell you the Club Wyndham points program. We attended the presentation and would’ve bought it if our immediate plans were different. They offer a complimentary shuttle to the strip so that is a plus. The strip is literally 5 minutes away and you are close to the freeway as well. The hotel requires a 2 night minimum and extending your stay for one extra night is a hassle. We had issues but Michelle at the front desk saved the day; she was kind, caring and went above and beyond to make sure her manager approved an extension. If you are looking to gamble, definitely not the place as the hotel doesn’t have a casino but it is perfect for families. We will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Very pleasant stay at this location. We successfully avoided the timeshare pitch by not getting the wristbands for elavator/room access. Our room was perfect size for a couple, really enjoyed having the partial kitchen. Would highly recommend and stay here again!!

reviews.title: A superb facility
reviews.text: What a pleasant surprise! From the moment we arrived till check out a superb experience. The suite was excellent, very nice and modernParking very convenient and freeNo waiting for the elevatorNo keys, wrist bands super easy to useFree shuttle to the stripStaff very friendly and well trainedOur first time here, usually stay at another well known time share property near planet Hollywood, this facility beats that asset hands down!We had a car so mobility was easy to get around. Probably the best equipped kitchen we have ever had. This will be our new go to location in Vegas. To the staff and management, thanks for making Christmas 2021 the best family Christmas ever!

reviews.title: Nice resort but no restaurants within walking distance.
reviews.text: Nice resort but no restaurants within walking distance. Only coffee at the resort is instant from a machine and the cost is $4 per cup. The resort staff is nice. The resort also has two computers for use by guests. The room is nice and big but has no table for eating in the room.

reviews.title: Whydham Blue Desert Rules
reviews.text: Within a mile to the strip and very well organized and relatively new, this resort beats the timeshare competition i9n the area. It has all sorts of amenities and ample garage, decent wifi, and almost all things for all ages. It has a shuttle to Cesar's Palace on the Strip and it is easily accessible.

reviews.title: Excellent spot
reviews.text: Recently stayed here when we were in Vegas. First time in Vegas, we wanted to be close to the strip, but not right on the strip. Perfect location for us. The service, from valet to check-in staff was excellent. Our room was just what we needed...it had the amenities we required.  Shuttle service to Caesars Palace was perfect.  Exercise room was decent for Covid times.  Pool area excellent but only one pool was open.As owners, if we return to Vegas, we will definitely stay here.

reviews.title: Great views, clean room and wonderful pool
reviews.text: Not on the strip but an easy 20 min walk to Cesar's Palace and 10 min walk to Hotel Rio. The band idea for room access was a novel , convenient idea instead of the credit card style room key which get easily demagnetized and a pain to work with. small pet peeve - Wish I was able to prop open the windows slightly to let some fresh air in.

reviews.title: Club Wyndham Desert Blue
reviews.text: What a beautiful facility!  my wife and loved our stay at the Club Wyndham.  Such an easy walk to and from the strip from the resort.  Our room was very clean and check in was a breeze.  I would recommend this resort, oh they also have a shuttle to and from the strip.

reviews.title: Nice resorr, good location
reviews.text: Nice resort. Paper thin walls allowed us to hear neighbor conversations that were awkward. The RCI $100 cleaning fee was unacceptable. The room will get cleaned whether we were RCI guests or not. That was a bunch of crap to get more money.

reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.text: It was a great room.  We got a studio ,but it was big enough for the 2 of us and the shuttle to Caesars helped out in not having to get a taxi/Lyft to different places. They also had a shuttle to the grocery store.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: It was a nice hotel with spacious rooms and free valet parking. The staff were very friendly and accommodating.  It's not on the strip but it wasn't far. The resort appears to be fairly new and I heard that it was built about two years ago. I recommend this stay for families that want to save a little money on eating out

reviews.title: Fun Vacation
reviews.text: This is a great place to stay. They had a daily list of activities in which you could chose to participate ranging from painting and arts and crafts to ukulele lessons.  The pool looked fun.  We were busy with friends staying elsewhere so we did not participate in any of the resort activities, but there were many.  The Rio is within walking distance....across the street. We enjoyed Guy Fieri's Ell Burro Borracho Restaurant at The Rio.  We also enjoyed Gold Coast Casino and the fabulous restaurants.  The resort has a shuttle to the strip but we did not use it.  We had a one bedroom which was extremely comfortable.  We made breakfast a few mornings in the room.  Great room set up.  We used the washer and dryer, which was so convenient.  We would definitely stay here again.   Extremely friendly staff.

reviews.title: Lovely Stay at Magnificent Resort
reviews.text: This was our first time at the Wyndham Desert Blue at Las Vegas, but we have been at other Wyndhams before. The resort has great amenities. It does not have a restaurant; but for breakfast they recommended a diner a block away and gave us instructions. We were very pleased with the breakfasts we had there. There is a shuttle that takes you to Caesar's Palace and picks you up from there back to the resort. The unit was sparkling clean, and fully equipped kitchen.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: I have been a Wyndham owner at Grand Desert in Vegas since 2003. We have been there several times for family gatherings and parties and have always been very satisfied. This year we thought we would try Wyndham Desert Blue Margaritaville. I reserved a three bedroom deluxe unit for August 14 - 18 to celebrate my birthday and we invited our daughter, her husband and our granddaughter to join us. We arrived at the resort at about 2 pm and registered understanding that our membership was VIP and entitled to early room occupation. The room was not ready when we arrived which is not an uncommon occurrence. We waited for about a half hour and we’re given our room keys. When we entered the room 2 men were working I’m the master bathroom. They said they were trying to fix a problem with the shower. They remained in there for another hour. When they left I asked them if the problem had been fixed and they replied “partially” but the water pressure was still low. I called the front desk after testing the shower confirming the workers reply. I was told that someone would be up later to investigate. We then went out and began our Vegas vacation. We had dinner and then went to the casino. My wife, whi is handicapped, wanted to return to the room to rest so she went up alone. Shen she got three her wristband key would not work so she called the desk. They told her to return but she was exhausted so finally someone came up to open the door. I arrived a couple of hours later and neither of my keys would work and I knocked loudly to awaken my wife and we both turned in for the night. When my daughter and her family returned Ed several hours later none of there keys worked. The next morning we were not able to shower because all that came out was scalding hot water with very low pressure so we called the desk and were informed they were waiting for a part. We did the best we could with sponge baths before heading out. The sink in the other bathroom also was having problems and my granddaughter burned her hand. I called the desk again and was assured the water problem would be fixed. I gave them permission to enter the room when we were out. When we returned that night I assumed the problem had been corrected. I went to take a much needed shower and nothing had changed. The next day I was very angry and spoke to David, the manager. He apologized but said there was a delay getting a necessary part to fix the shower. This is now the day of our Lon awaited birthday dinner at Bobby Flay’s new restaurant. As we were sited I received a text message reminding me that we were due to check out the next morning which was August 17th. My reservation was for the 14th through the 18th. I panicked and interrupted the dinner to call the front desk. I was told that I was mistaken and put on hold for 10 minutes. When she returned she said I was wrong and we had to leave the room the next morning. I found out much later after my dinner was destroyed that it was not my mistake but Wyndham’s mistake. The next morning I called David, the manager again about still nothing being done about the shower and the reservation mix up. He asked me what he could do to make this up to us. I replied that is up to you. He called back later and said the suite would be comped and to look for a refund of points by the end of the week. When I returned home I checked and by the following Monday I saw that 90000 points had beenreturned to my account. The problem is the point total for the suite was 210000 points. BEWARE OF WYNDHAM DESERT BLUE MARGARITAVILLE!

reviews.title: Great Off Strip Option.
reviews.text: Stayed in the 2 room Presidential. Beautiful room with a beautiful view. Room was ready 2 hours early. Bellmen and valet were all super prompt and helpful. We cooked all 3 days in the room and it had everything we needed. Definitely not walkable to the strip, nor did we expect it to be. We did not use the shuttle. Uber cost from the Condo to directly where we wanted to go was reasonable. Pool was great and not over crowded on the weekday we used it. No reservation required. There is a 2nd floor walk over with stairs going to the pool that is oddly not acceptable. I guess maybe it is office space. Just kinda odd that you have to walk out the front door by valet and walk across a drive way to the pool. We split our trip with 3 days here and 3 days on the strip. Made for a great mix of a vacation.

reviews.title: Not as fun as could have been
reviews.text: The pool closed early every day @ 8 pm - Some of their staff isn't trained as well as should be - they gave the wrong answer to a few different questions. If they don't know answer say, let me check into that- don't guess and give me the wrong information... Property needs a restaurant -Only saving grace The BEDS are VERY comfortable.

reviews.title: Resort not staffed for reopening after pandemic.
reviews.text: Could have been a nice vacation but due to VERY limited hours and amenities for the number of guests at the resort it was very disappointing. Had we had advance notice of all the limitations still in place, due to lack of staff to provide those services, we would have had the opportunity to choose another resort.  The heat is so bad there during the day that we were forced to spend way too much time in our room since no other resort owner activities were provided and the small game room was so over crowded it was literally impossible to use. On the positive side, the pool area was always kept clean and the staff, (especially the manager, Jack) was friendly during the limited hours of availability.

reviews.title: We loved it!
reviews.text: We had a great time staying at Desert Blue Wyndham.  Friendly staff and convenient location.  Even though my kids were bummed that kids activities center was closed due to Covid, there were still plenty to do at the resort, such as pool, arcade, activity room, and the gym.  There were sanitizers everywhere and all the facilities were cleaned sanitized between use.  Super easy check in and out.  Convenient location to the Strip, grocery stores, and restaurants!  We stayed in a one bedroom suite in Margaritaville and the room design was very beachy-feel and relaxing!  There was even a Margarita Mixer with secret recipe in the room.  All kitchenware were enough to satisfy my needs.  My kids didn't want to leave and already asked to come back next time.  Will definitely visit again!

reviews.title: Resort to Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: The resort is close to everything. There is a shuttle service going to Ceasars Palace and Fashion Show mall. The resort and services are good for family; however, the policy for no smoking must be strictly prohibited, including  weeds.

reviews.title: Great vegas stay
reviews.text: This was a wonderful stay. The only reason i rated this 4of 5 is because i arrived around 4:30 and my room was not ready yet. I left and came back later that evening and room was ready. I had a 1 bedroom which was awesome. Beautiful and clean room with nice view of pool, the Rio and strip. Bed was clean, large fridge, nice dinner table. Washer and dryer with detergent provided for 2 loads.  Nice bathroom. It would have been nice to have more towels left initially but you can ask for more. Valet was free and great, but not sure what time it ends because we arrived around midnight one night and there was no one doing valet so we self parked. All amenities appear to be opened. They have a shuttle that will take you to the strip and even grocery store. I will definitely stay here again when visiting las vegas.

reviews.title: Worth every pennies
reviews.text: This accommodation blew me away. Stayed at the Two-Bedroom Presidential Suite. Can see the strip from all the windows on the 17th-floor. It is more subtle than the strip itself, which surprisingly is what I preferred now. You can take a five-minutes drive, shuttle, or just walk as the strip is less than a mile away. Check-in was fast and staffs was courteous. Will definitely considered this if we are in Las Vegas again.

reviews.title: Great property and location
reviews.text: This property is across from the Rio and pretty new.  Our 1 BR was clean and up to date.  Things were just opening up from Covid so most days the pool was pretty empty.  There are 2 pools that are heated.  One hot tub wasn't working but the other was working and open while we were there.  I imagine once things get much busier that the pool area could be pretty crowded but wasn't busy while we were there.  We had a car to get around so can't speak to the shuttle or amenities as we didn't use them.  The gym was small but adequate.  Overall a very nice off the strip place.

reviews.title: Accommodating Resort
reviews.text: I love the convenience of the shuttle and the resort staff that went out of their way to help us have a wonderful stay at the resort. Staff are very friendly and helpful. My mother is on wheel chair and I forgot to book a room that has handicapped shower. So they found a bath chair for my Mom but the shower head needs to be replaced to handheld so I can bath my Mom, they actually went out to buy a new shower head and installed it in my room to solve this big issue I have. I appreciated very much for their efforts.

reviews.title: Rough mornings
reviews.text: Was woken up at 7am the whole week stay during with renovation noises from the room up top. I wish I was advised a head of time of the renovation or moved to another room. However, this is the first time I have ever had problems with this resort. To conclude, I always stay at this resort when I come to Vegas. Love the pool..

reviews.title: THE MOST TERRIBLE HOTEL
reviews.text: This is the most terrible place I've ever been to. We were supposed to check-in on the 8th and check-out date was on the 11th of April. We didn't get there until the next day probably at 3:00 A.M. They were helpless when I asked for a couple of hours extension at the time of our check-out instead of paying roughly $200 for a day extra before heading to the airport they told us to come back a day prior check-out. This place is inconvenient to anything, you have to either drive or UBER there's nothing walking distance. None of us drove we thought that it was only a walking distance to the strip but it's not. They have restaurant inside but its not open until 11:00 A.M. If you like to gamble or grab a drink, this hotel has nothing to offer or nothing nearby. They have pool but you have to call for reservation. Customer service was horrible. They gave us keys for our room w/o telling us that they have more than 1 type of keys they're giving to costumers until few ladies we met in the elevator telling us to go back because our keys were not correct and that they should give us wristbands type to have access to our room and elevator. One lady walked down with us back to the front desk and did not want to leave us alone. It was just a ridiculous experience dragging our luggage back and forth. The room was bad. We literally had to climb over furniture to get to things, it was so tight. The room was supposed to accommodate 4 people and there were 3 of us but the dining table had only 2 chairs and the table it's like a bench attached to the wall probably measures 2x4 and you would hit it as you open the door from the outside. Bathroom was for  handicap, water all over the place when someone takes a shower. The shower curtain was high off the floor. It was ridiculous that we had to sit down to take a  hand shower but water still flowing all over the place. My friends went to sleep with their hair wet. There was no hair dryer. I called the front desk for it and told me to check on drawers but there was no drawers whatsoever in the bathroom it was just a sink and pipe underneath I saw. It was a stressful stay so I called my husband to find us a different hotel ASAP. Thankfully he was able to get us one at Grand View and paid extra money just to get out of this horrible hotel.  So, we checked out after few hours of stay in this most horrible hotel and the guy at the front desk did not care at all not even trying to figure out something. No apologies whatsoever.

reviews.title: Great spot off the strip
reviews.text: Nice, clean, family-friendly spot in a good location with access to everything you need. Great pool facilities. Shuttle to the strip & to local grocery. Rooms are equipped with everything you need for your stay!

reviews.title: Room with a view
reviews.text: We like to come to Vegas at least twice a year.  This has been one of our favorites.  Plenty of parking, easy to get around from, and a comfortable apt. with everything we needed. Will ask for a view of the Rio the next time

reviews.title: Pot smokers heaven.
reviews.text: Hall ways and elevators are full of pot smoke.Staff refuses to enforce the rules and say they can’t control what the other guests do. I say kick them out. It’s a shame because otherwise this is a beautiful and clean facility.

reviews.title: Immaculate Property
reviews.text: If you don't want to deal with the hassles of checking in and out of most of the Vegas Hotels/Casinos, and trying to find parking, this is the place to stay. The property and its grounds were immaculate. The staff was very professional, the pools were pristine, and there was ample parking. My wife and I stayed 5 nights, checking in on 11/8/20, in a 1-bedroom presidential suite, and it was very clean and loaded with luxury. Bonuses like modern decor, high ceilings, hot tub in the room, 2 bathrooms, washer/dryer, updated appliances in the kitchen, along with plenty of dishware (ie. pots, pans, eating utensils, glasses, cups, etc.), made us feel pampered. We had awesome views of the Strip and the mountains! Every time we returned to the property from eating, shopping, or gambling, the crew at the front desk welcomed us back. We opted out of paying for housekeeping, but anytime we needed anything (like toilet paper, coffee, towels), they were there in a timely manner. We will definitely be back!!!

reviews.title: Clean, well-lighted place.....(Dylan Thomas)
reviews.text: We stopped here driving to California. It was very nice. Sadly everything to do in Vegas is closed. Some restaurants are open but ZERO shows. Several casinos are closed as well, including Rio and Planet Hollywood. Clean place, nice staff, quiet, but a bit isolated. One caveat....do NOT do the owner update. HUGE mistake. Rude, poor communication skills, and unhelpful.

reviews.title: They limited our vacay with covid
reviews.text: We enjoyed staying here.  However, our room was directly next to the trash chute and our walk to and from the room smelled horrid (no smell in the room). And we went during covid so the pool hours were limited from 7a-10p to 11a-7p; I really didn’t understand this as it actually doesn’t prevent covid since they limited the number of people. That being said, it took us 3 days to be able to go to the pool.  They told us “we could only book two days ahead” but we arrived at 830 am and somehow the pool was ‘booked’ for the next two days already? Made no sense.  Then we were told to just show up and hope they had an opening-we didn’t like this option since we could’ve stayed on the strip longer if we knew we couldn’t go to the pool. We were told the shuttle had 4 stops.  However it only had one stop on the strip. We never got to the south end of the strip because being dropped off at caesars it was miles walk just to get that far and back. The shuttle did take us to the grocery store which was nice.  The shuttle had a sign that said tips are encouraged.  I felt like that was pushy since we already paid for a nice hotel (off the strip) knowing we would have a shuttle.  Not to mention in our 4 days, we had at least 4-5 shuttle drivers and we hadn’t planned on tipping them (most weren’t good drivers). One of the drivers even said “tips are appreciated” like we already had seen the sign we didn’t need her making it awkward.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Reserved a beautiful 2 bedroom presidential suite. Much more than needed. Beautiful space. High end appliances. High ceilings. Huge windows. Staff was exceptional. Picked up the phone immediately and Was never put in hold. Unfortunately because of covered. The game room and the pool hall room were closed. But the market and the business room were still open. But they had to wipe stations everywhere. The gym was open but to a much limited capacity. The pool was beautiful but the kids splash section and the two Jacuzzis were closed. But the pool was also empty while we were out there. There could banners are extremely cheap and only 100 bucks. My only issue is that this place is a timeshare so there's no daily housekeeping. They do offer daily housekeeping but at an absurd price. This place is extremely clean. Would definitely stay here again

reviews.title: Book now!
reviews.text: Loved this resort! Comfy beds, soft sheets, 2 bedroom & 2 bath suite was perfect for family of 5 even the sofa bed was comfy. There is a shuttle that takes you to the strip every night. Fitness room is medium size but has everything you need. The room was very clean.

reviews.title: Enjoyed my stay
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at the Club Wyndham Desert Blue.  Zach and his team were very nice and accommodating.  Even though the bed was very firm, when I requested extra padding, they didn't hesitate to send it.  I enjoyed the pool area and the Cabanas.  The property Is well keep and very safe.  It was close enough, yet far enough from the Las Vegas Strip to enjoy your peace and quiet.  I will return.

reviews.title: Well kept property
reviews.text: My husband & I are Wyndham owners.  We had planned on going to NOLA but changed to a staycation in Vegas due to COVID.  Very glad we asked for a Mountainview instead of Rio view room as the Rio is closed and at night it’s just dark. Our view was the Stratosphere, Wynn&Encore and the new Resorts World under construction.Our 1 bedroom had a very comfortable king sized bed with excellent linens. A huge bathroom with seperate jetted tub, a big glass shower, the tub is actually in the bedroom area.  There is a pocket door to close off the bathroom from bedroom if you were sharing the 1 bedroom with kids and it is plenty big for a family of four!  The toilet & sink have a door by the kitchen so you needn’t walk thru the bedroom to access which is really nice. Both the bedroom & living area have ceiling fans.  I read other reviews that said the furnishings were showing wear.  We did not find this to be true.The pools are great!!! The kids splash pad & the hot tubs were closed due to COVID & you needed to reserve your morning & afternoon times, very easy.  They do close the pool area from 2:30-3:30 to clean/sanitize.We highly recommend staying here!

reviews.title: Mostly a good place to stay.
reviews.text: It was overpriced (as in point value). The furniture looked beat up (wasn’t sure if it was sopposed to be aged or just poor condition). The beds were uncomfortable as was the couch in the living room, so much so no one sat on the couch. The location was fine (behind the RIO, but the hotel and casino had not reopened). The lobby was very nice, the halls and elevators were also very nice. The room at first glance was very nice, until you noticed the furniture.

reviews.title: Time share preso
reviews.text: We visited the Club Wyndham Desert Blue for a visit to consider a timeshare.  The hotel was nice and had some great views from the top floors.  Of course the timeshare presentation was longer than promised due to the delays shuttling back and forth, but it was nice to see the views.This hotel is well off the strip and not easily within walking distance to the action.  View photo attached.

reviews.title: Wyndham Desert Blue makes for a great trip to Vegas
reviews.text: We spent the week (Nov 24 - Dec 1, 2019) at the Wyndham Desert Blue in Las Vegas. We had a 1-BR unit on the 8th floor with a view towards the Strip which was more than I expected considering the location of the resort itself. Location is a bit of a drawback since you need to drive to get to everything.We found the resort to be delightful! It was clean and new (upper floors still being built) and very nicely appointed. The common areas were lovely. The pool area was beautiful and the water was kept at a toasty temperature (getting out was not so lovely since it was quite cool in Vegas the week we were there). There were no fees for any of the activities which was a very pleasant surprise since most resorts charge for everything except the most basic of things. Board games were plentiful in the teen/kid area and could be played there or checked out to take to your room. Beds were comfortable. Kitchen was nicely appointed. Outlets for charging devices were readily available. The only thing we found lacking was the existence of a DVD player. Since we have a fairly young kid, we always travel with a small case of DVDs so that the child can watch a movie a couple times during the vacation. There was no DVD player that we could find attached to either TV. Not a huge issue but was a surprise to us.The resort offered a free shuttle to the grocery store each day (you need to be a fast shopper to take advantage of it, as you only got about 15 minutes in the store!) They also offered a free shuttle multiple times a day to the Strip with drop off and pick up at Caesar's Palace (I think I'm recalling that correctly). This was fine, but one time when we took it, we went back for pickup and the shuttle never showed up. It was very cold with horrible wind, so we went back inside Caesar's Palace to await the next one and made sure we got back outside a little early.We would absolutely stay at this property again (or try another Wyndham resort, as this was our first!). Everything about our time at the resort was pleasant. Employees were friendly and helpful. Wifi worked without issue. All around, a great stay.

reviews.title: Loved this nice & quiet location away from the Strip
reviews.text: For the last two years (while here for a conference) we have stayed in resorts on the Strip. This year we had our 18 year old travelling with us so wanted to have seperate rooms and a kitchen (so we didn't have to eat out for all meals). I booked the Wyndham Desert Blue via airbnb. Sadly our room wasn't available when we arrived (fair enough since it was just 10am but we were super tired after our trip from Australia). However we were given a room upgrade so that was nice. It was 3 bedroom (something) and really something special. The view, if you didn't look straight done, was stunning, esp at night. The whole complex is lovely and we really appreciated the lack of crowds and casino smoke. It was pretty cold when we were here so we didn't get to use the pool (that would have been a great thing to do when we arrived and were waiting for our room. Highly recommend this place. If we return to Vegas we will stay here again. Oh, we didn't have a car, just used Uber to get around. Though they do offer a shuttle. Only asked once or twice about the time share presentation - which we were not at all interested in.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay.
reviews.text: We enjoyed our week at this resort, we usually stay at the Wyndham Grand Desert but found we preferred the shuttle service at this resort, you can hop on to go to the Rio or over to Caesars Palace.  We had a 2 bedroom/2 bath which was comfortable, we had family visit a couple of nights and had no issues. The unit we had was showing some wear and will require renovation fairly soon...that said it was still very comfortable. The pool area is very nice and the staff was attentive. Overall we found the staff at this resort to be excellent.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: We were told there would not be any housekeeping, but if we needed anything to come to the front desk. We didn't have any problem with this system, but it sure isn't handy to have to ask for coffee packets every morning. There is no restaurant in the hotel, but I guess there is food at the pool bar. It was rainy and cold the time we were there, we didn't go to the pool bar. When you check in, they send you over to another desk to get your parking pass and information on the resort, but it really is a chance to bribe you make an appointment for their time-share information. We only had to say no 4 times. But even with that we were given a card with a phone number in case we changed our mind. Suite was nice, full kitchen, one bathroom, but 2 separate sinks, nice soaking tub and large shower. For some reason the first day it took a LONG TIME to get the water to be hot in both the sink and the shower. Was better for the rest of the stay.

reviews.title: Beautiful Property But Not Sure It's Worth The Sales Pitch
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Wyndham Desert Blue during a short stay in Vegas in October and, while the property is beautiful, I'm not sure it's worth having to deal with the sales pitch that comes with it.My parents are Wyndham owners.  They bought back when it was Fairfield in 2001 and eventually transitioned to Wyndham.  The Desert Blue is Wyndham's newer Vegas property and my parents had suggested we stay there during our Vegas leg of our West Coast trip.  We were appreciative of the free accommodations so we took them up on their generous offer.The Wyndham Desert Blue is a beautiful property.  Everything was immaculate, including the rooms.  We had booked a 1-bedroom suite a few months before our trip, which they said wasn't available upon check-in, so they upgraded us to a 2-bedroom that had a huge living, dining, and kitchenette area, as well as two bedrooms and two bathrooms.  The master bath had a large jacuzzi tub with a half wall separating it from the bedroom and a huge shower.  We only stayed in the master bedroom.  The king bed was very comfortable.Our only issue was during check-in.  At this point, we're used to the annoying spiel we have to go through every time we check into a Wyndham property with my parents timeshare but it doesn't get any less frustrating.  We actually arrived to check-in wearing a wedding gown and tuxedo because we had just renewed our vows at the Venetian.  The person who initially checked us in was very friendly and efficient, then referred us to the other counter to "get our parking pass."  You would think the staff would recognize that two people in full wedding attire and holding a bouquet probably had plans for the night but that didn't stop them from wasting 15 minutes of our time trying to convince us to come to whatever seminar they were having that week.  My favorite was how they tried to frame it as their "wedding present to us," as if they wouldn't offer the same to literally anyone they were trying to get to attend the seminar.  They offered us a few different incentives including show tickets and gift cards, but we repeatedly told them that it was a short trip and it was already planned and paid for (which was true).   We still had to decline their offers an excessive number of times to get on with our night, again, despite having told them we had just renewed our vows and that we had plans for the night.It's disappointing that we have these experiences every time we come to a Wyndham property and it continues to reenforce my intention to never sit through one of their seminars (or showcases or whatever else they're calling their sales pitch this time) and to never put any more money into my parents' timeshare.  It's a shame because their properties are beautiful and other than the sales staff, their staff members are always friendly and attentive.  Maybe if they eased up on the sales tactics, we'd be willing to consider their offers but for now, every time I deal with it, I question whether or not I should be staying there.

reviews.title: Viva Wyndham Desert Blue
reviews.text: The Wyndham Desert Blue Resort made my trip to Las Vegas a most memorable one. The kindness and attention to detail by the associated was fantastic and I would highly recommend this resort to my friends.

reviews.title: Best Bet in Vegas
reviews.text: The Wyndham Desert Blue is a new construction luxury high rise just off the strip. In fact, our tour guide one day had never heard of it. If you are reserving online through a third party, do not get confuesed with the other area Wyndham properties- the Grand Desert and the Rose or you cou ld find yourself at the wrong place. We self parked our rental, although valet parking was also available and free. Checkin was welcoming, quick, and easy although I was kind of loaded down with the room keys, shuttle schedule, parking pass, and shuttle wrist bands, and other infomation. The Blue is family friendly as there is no casino and no smoky smell or age restrictions. There also is no buffet but there are a number of restaurants nearby. During our multi night stay, we took advantage of the free shuttle to go to Rio ( it is straight across from the Blue, but the parking lot access was blocked for a special event so it would have been a long walk around) and for trips to and from the strip (It drops off and picks up at Caesars). Our two bedroom presidential suite with full kitcehn and living room  was perfect for us and our autistic son and we all slept more soundly than anywhere else on the two week trip. Our room had a view of the RIo and the strip.  I am a Wyndham club member so it was also a reasonable rate. There is even a game room and small library in addition to the standard amenities. The whole building and grounds were clean and quiet, which was nice. The only thing I didn't like was being presssured to sign up for a free breakfast and tour to promote timeshares, which I will never buy anywhere. Finally signed up for our last morning, then cancelled. Still got a text reminder that mormning, but no means no. We just checked out and left. Again, we had made reservations and paid ahead through the Wyndham site, so everything was covered so all I had to do was hand in the key cards. All hotel personnel we encountered were profesional, friendly, helpful and appeared to enjoy their work and be proud of the organization. We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Superb Vacation!
reviews.text: This was a top notch vacation resort, down to the decor, rooms and staff. A must stay if your going to Vegas. We will stay at this property again. The resort was decorated beautifully for Christmas and is a short trip from the strip which a shuttle ride is provided.

reviews.title: Very Nice Wyndham - Off the Strip
reviews.text: Great, "clean" nicely appointed two-bedroom suite.  We purchased a timeshare (Don't judge us) in 2000 in Vegas and had never used it in Vegas until October 2019.  We were pleased with this location and appreciated it being off the Strip for the sake of getting a peaceful nights-sleep.  If you long for a place to provide you non-stop action, countless amenities and all of the hoopla that goes with it - the Wyndham Desert Blue is not the place for you.  If you instead desire place to lay your head that is clean, safe, friendly - you will enjoy it.  We would stay again for sure.

reviews.title: Nice property
reviews.text: One bedroom is nice for 2 adults but fold out couch was terrible for an adult. Shuttle was very convenient to go two casinos but only holds 13 people so be early to ride the shuttle or expect to call Uber/Lyft.

reviews.title: Off the Strip, beautiful new property
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at the Wyndham Desert Blue. Beds, comforter and pillows were super comfortable. The staff was very attentive, always calling to see if we needed anything. Our only concern was the lack of food options. We had a car and used it to the grocery store a few times. They do offer a free shuttle to the Strip and grocery store. It was a great place to stay, away from the noise and congestion of the Strip. We did have a rental car, but used Uber to go back and forth.

reviews.title: Nice off strip resort
reviews.text: We were 4 adults + 1 infant.  2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment on the 6th floor.  Corner unit. Apartment was nice.  Had everything you need - cutlery, crockery, mixer, toaster, etc.  Dining table for 6. Full size stove & refrigerator.  Room cooling worked very well.  Location is good, just off strip.  About 20 or so minute walk if you want to walk, or $10 uber or lyft ride.  They also have an hourly shuttle that's complementary.  No casino, which was gr8. Complementary parking. 'Complementary' valet parking as well.  They have some activities including beer tasting, margaritas, etc. at no additional cost.  Nothing to write home about, but pleasant enough if you are there at the scheduled time.Place itself was nice.  Newer property.  Seems fairly well maintained. Front desk said it wasnt fully open.  Some construction on the side - didnt bother us.  2 pools.  We didnt want to do the timeshare presentation & other than being asked a couple of times, were not bothered/ pushed.I would recommend this place if -1) you want to be off strip2) you want an apartment vs. a hotel room 3) you dont want a casino in the hotel

reviews.title: It's like I live in Las Vegas
reviews.text: My family came out to Vegas for a wedding.  When I arrived, I stayed with my sister in their two bedroom unit.  It is very spacious and comfortable.  I then moved into a three bedroom Presidential Suite with my parents.  Lots of room to move around in!  I slept in a king room with it's own bathroom.  My parents had the room with a jacuzzi.  I also took a nap in the third bathroom because it was the coldest room with good afternoon light to read.  We like having a washer and dryer and the kitchen comes in handy.  The hallway lighting to the units are very subdued which is nice.Keep in mind, this is a stand alone property that is part of the Wyndham timeshares.  You may be asked to attend a seminar but they do have some nice gifts.  If you want to go anywhere, you need to drive and if you don't have a car, there is a shuttle service to the strip.  I like that it's not near the strip.  It's quieter!  No one smokes!  It doesn't have a casino or bar so there's no obnoxious drunks.  Also, everyone is really friendly, especially housekeeping and maintenance.  The one thing I didn't like was that the units do warm up in the late afternoon if you don't draw the curtains.  Other than that, this is a great place to stay!I should've used the pool because it looked great from our room.

reviews.title: THE BEST RCI RESORT IN LAS VEGAS
reviews.text: Rooms are large.  We stayed in a 2 bedroom unit on the 6th floor.  Was well maintained.  Staff was the nicest people ever.  Been a RCI member for 20 years and this is, by far, the best resort we have ever stayed.

reviews.title: Good resort
reviews.text: Nice place but the lack of optional maid service  is why I probably would not stay there again.  I am vacation and do not want to clean my own room...some people prefer not to have maid service but one should have the option to have it if they would like.

reviews.title: Great timeshare exchange, 2-bed 2-bath unit, full kitchen, washer/dryer
reviews.text: This resort was great, the unit was clean, spacious, in good working order. Everyone was very nice and very focused on customer service. No heavy pressure sales pitch at check in. We stayed as a time share exchange.

reviews.title: Our Wedding  9/7/19
reviews.text: We were treated very well by manger Alicia Miller and entire staff. Shuttle service was excellent and the daily activities on the property. We did not have a Chance to us the pool but the activities room was the right size and view for our wedding / Reception

reviews.title: Smaller and quieter than Desert Grand.
reviews.text: Units are a bit more compact.  The dining table blocks your path into the room but really no other place for it.  Easy to take the shuttle to the Rio or walk across the Rio parking lot, but not an easy walk to anything else.  Nice splash pad for kids and nice but smallish pool.

reviews.title: One of nicest timeshares that I have been to.
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and the staff extremely nice.  Although it’s not on the strip, they have free shuttles and it’s worth it to stay here.  We are Wyndham Presidential reserve and received a number of extra perks.

reviews.title: Anniversary Weekend
reviews.text: Great place to stay. Not too crowded. Pool area is nice and peaceful. Staff is very helpful and accomadating, just a little pushy for you to attend their sales pitch. We had a great time and really enjoyed our stay.

reviews.title: Great Resort in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Wyndham Desert Blue resort is a few blocks off the Strip in Las Vegas (across the I-15 from Caesar's Palace).  It's luxurious and quiet.  Our family had a wonderful time there.  Pools were excellent and staff very helpful.

reviews.title: a vacation with our grandaughter
reviews.text: Especially High marks for service and security. Houskeeping called do alert us that towels were on the way and then checked back to make sure all was delivered and OK. Pool and surrounding was always clean and neat . Not a lot of kids so much quieter than Grand Desert. pool .A little off the strip but shuttle was provided and Lyft  cost about $8.00 to center of strip.

reviews.title: Awesome Stay!!
reviews.text: I arrived at about 5am Monday morning from an 8 hr layover in Chicago. Fortunately my check in went really quick. I got up to my room and it was very spacious and nice. I was very tired so I jumped in the shower and went straight to sleep. The beds were very comfortable. I enjoyed my week there and look forward to visiting again.

reviews.title: Intentionally Deceptive Practices
reviews.text: Wyndham offering show tickets to do a 2 hrs timeshare pitch. The 2 hrs turned into 4 hrs and they just kept coming up with more stuff. Then when we didnt buy they cared nothing to even get us back to our hotel. Bad practices!!!
